_note: Plain-English wording for The Five Food Trucks, written once and stored so the demo needs no API key. Keys are group ids from to_ai_payload; every id must appear exactly once, which narrate.problems_with checks and a test enforces against the live trace.

prose.1: Nina parks immediately to the right of Quinn, so Quinn cannot be at the far east end with nobody beyond him, and Nina cannot be at truck 1 with nobody before her.
prose.2: The waffle truck sits somewhere to the left of the falafel truck, so the waffles cannot be at truck 5 and the falafel cannot be at truck 1.
prose.3: "The orange truck is parked at the east end" settles orange at truck 5: no other truck is orange, and truck 5 is no other colour.
prose.4: Red, teal, purple and cream are all gone from truck 5, so orange it is.
prose.5: Rosa's truck is cream, and truck 5 is orange, so truck 5 is not Rosa.
prose.6: The waffle truck plays rock, and truck 5 has no waffles, so it does not play rock.
prose.7: The red truck plays folk, and truck 5 is orange rather than red, so no folk there either.
prose.8: Rosa sells the tacos, and truck 5 is not Rosa, so the tacos are not at truck 5.
prose.9: Omar's truck is purple, and truck 5 is orange, so truck 5 is not Omar.
prose.10: The falafel truck plays pop, and truck 1 has no falafel, so truck 1 does not play pop.
prose.11: The orange truck plays the blues, and truck 1 is not orange, so no blues at truck 1.
prose.12: Truck 2 is not orange either, so no blues there.
prose.13: Nor truck 3 — not orange, so not the blues.
prose.14: Nor truck 4, for exactly the same reason.
prose.15: The blues has to be playing somewhere, and trucks 1 to 4 are all ruled out, so it must be truck 5 — which means truck 5 plays neither jazz nor pop.
prose.16: Rock and folk were already impossible at truck 5, so the blues is what remains.
prose.17: The falafel truck plays pop, and truck 5 plays the blues, so truck 5 has no falafel.
prose.18: The falafel is not at truck 5, and the waffles must sit somewhere to its left, so the waffles cannot be at truck 4 either.
prose.19: The waffle truck plays rock, and truck 4 has no waffles, so no rock at truck 4.
prose.20: Quinn is at one end of the street. Trying each end in turn, truck 1 comes out the same way both times: not Rosa, not Omar, not Priya.
prose.21: Nina was already impossible at truck 1, so Quinn parks at the west end.
prose.22: The same both-ends check keeps Quinn out of trucks 2, 3 and 4.
prose.23: Nina parks immediately right of Quinn, and truck 2 is not Quinn, so Nina is not at truck 3.
prose.24: Truck 3 is not Quinn either, so Nina is not at truck 4.
prose.25: And truck 4 is not Quinn, so Nina is not at truck 5.
prose.26: Nina, Omar, Quinn and Rosa are all ruled out of truck 5, so Priya is parked at the east end.
prose.27: Rosa sells the tacos, and truck 1 is not Rosa, so no tacos at truck 1.
prose.28: Omar's truck is purple, and truck 1 is not Omar, so truck 1 is not purple.
prose.29: Priya sells the noodles, and truck 1 is not Priya, so no noodles at truck 1.
prose.30: Working through both ways the gyros can neighbour the tacos, truck 2 comes out the same every time: not Rosa, not Omar, not Priya.
prose.31: Quinn is at truck 1, so with the other three ruled out, truck 2 is Nina.
prose.32: The same both-ways check keeps Priya out of trucks 3 and 4.
prose.33: Rosa's truck is cream, and truck 1 is not Rosa, so truck 1 is not cream.
prose.34: Truck 2 is not Rosa either, so it is not cream.
prose.35: Rosa sells the tacos, and truck 2 is not Rosa, so no tacos at truck 2.
prose.36: Omar's truck is purple, and truck 2 is not Omar, so truck 2 is not purple.
prose.37: Priya sells the noodles, and truck 2 is not Priya, so no noodles at truck 2.
prose.38: Truck 3 is not Priya, so no noodles there.
prose.39: Nor truck 4 — not Priya, so not the noodles.
prose.40: Checking the gyros on each side of the tacos, truck 1 cannot have the gyros either way.
prose.41: Tacos, noodles, falafel and gyros are all out at truck 1, so Quinn sells the waffles.
prose.42: The same check clears the waffles from trucks 2 and 3, and the gyros from truck 5.
prose.43: Tacos, waffles, falafel and gyros are all gone from truck 5, so Priya sells the noodles.
prose.44: The waffle truck plays rock, and truck 2 has no waffles, so no rock at truck 2.
prose.45: Truck 3 has no waffles either, so no rock there.
prose.46: The rock has to be playing somewhere, and trucks 2 to 5 are all ruled out, so it must be truck 1 — which means truck 1 plays neither jazz nor folk.
prose.47: The blues and pop were already impossible at truck 1, so Quinn's waffle truck plays rock.
prose.48: The red truck plays folk, and truck 1 plays rock, so truck 1 is not red.
prose.49: Red, orange, purple and cream are all out at truck 1, so it is the teal one.
prose.50: Checking both ways round again, truck 2 cannot be teal.
prose.51: Orange, teal, purple and cream are all gone from truck 2, so Nina's truck is red.
prose.52: The same check rules teal and red out of trucks 3 and 4 alike.
prose.53: The red truck plays folk, and truck 3 is not red, so no folk at truck 3.
prose.54: Truck 4 is not red either, so no folk there.
prose.55: Working through both ways once more, truck 2 plays neither pop nor jazz.
prose.56: Rock and the blues were already out at truck 2, so Nina's red truck plays folk — which is what the clue promised of the red one.
prose.57: The falafel truck plays pop, and truck 2 plays folk, so no falafel at truck 2.
prose.58: Tacos, noodles, waffles and falafel are all ruled out at truck 2, so Nina sells the gyros.
prose.59: The same both-ways check clears the falafel and the gyros from truck 3.
prose.60: Noodles and waffles were already gone from truck 3, so the tacos are there.
prose.61: And the same both-ways check rules the tacos and the gyros out of truck 4.
prose.62: Noodles and waffles were already impossible at truck 4, so it sells the falafel.
prose.63: Rosa sells the tacos, and truck 4 has none, so truck 4 is not Rosa.
prose.64: Nina, Priya, Quinn and Rosa are all placed elsewhere, so truck 4 is Omar's.
prose.65: The falafel truck plays pop, and truck 3 has no falafel, so no pop at truck 3.
prose.66: Rock, folk, blues and pop are all out at truck 3, so it plays jazz.
prose.67: One more pass over both sides of the tacos rules Omar out of truck 3.
prose.68: Nina, Priya and Quinn are elsewhere too, so Rosa's truck is number 3 — which fits, since she sells the tacos.
prose.69: And the same check rules jazz out of truck 4.
prose.70: Rock, folk and the blues were already gone from truck 4, so Omar's falafel truck plays pop.
prose.71: Rosa's truck is cream, and truck 4 is not Rosa, so truck 4 is not cream.
prose.72: Red, orange and cream are all out at truck 4, so Omar's truck is purple — exactly as his clue said.
prose.73: Purple is now settled at truck 4, so no other truck can be purple, truck 3 included.
prose.74: Red, orange and purple are all gone from truck 3, so Rosa's truck is cream — and the whole street is settled.
